purpose: Canonical three-axis political cube configuration. The existing political lexicon supplies the first two normalized coordinates; the third axis is reserved for social-cultural openness and must not be fabricated where unsupported.
data_policy: Economic and authority coordinates may be read from data/political-lexicon.json. Social-cultural coordinates require explicit evidence or a documented analytical assignment; absence is preferable to invented precision.
epistemic_note: Coordinates are comparative analytical instruments, not objective measurements of the moral value or total content of an ideology. Historical and country-specific variants should be modeled separately.
